hint.text:
There are 4 rules to follow when dealing with Roman numerals:

1. Add numerals together if there is more than one of the same, e.g. III = 3.

2. If a larger numeral comes before a smaller numeral, add them together, e.g. LI = 51.

3. If a smaller numeral comes before a larger numeral, take away the smaller numeral from the larger numeral, e.g. IV = 4.

4. Always do any subtraction first.
